name: dining table
caption: A dining table with a wide top, four legs and a straight apron. A framed top joins four legs; a straight apron links the legs. Flat tabletop panels keep a constant thickness with squared legs. Overall width is 1.55 times depth; height is 0.72 times width. Parts follow functional positions.
